summary: K'aresh is the ethereals' homeworld, and it is in pieces: an arid desert planet whose twin suns were eaten and whose sky went from saffron to Void-purple, now a husk with habitable fragments strung around it. Ve'nari's K'aresh Trust has moved Tazavesh back home and is trying to grow the place green again under purchased eco-domes, while the Wastelanders survive on the debris and the Shadowguard feed the Manaforge at Shadow Point. What that manaforge is for is bringing Dimensius back.
history: Before the Void, this was a desert world of city-states — Tazavesh, Ma'nussa, Sufaad and the rest — ruled by a Council of Oracles who could hear the planet's worldsoul sing and renewed their oaths to him in ritual. Then Dimensius arrived and opened gateways to the Void all around the sky. The K'areshi threw up shields fed by ribbons that turned any energy into arcane; the shields held, and the arcane burned their bodies off them, which is where ethereals come from. They fought him to a standstill until he could summon armies, and fled into the Nether and the Shadowlands. Everyone believes he destroyed the world. He did not — their own people broke it, to keep him from swallowing the worldsoul.
factions: K'aresh Trust — the broker cartels with the Consortium's ethereals
Xal'atath, in an alliance nobody is comfortable with
